display_sensor.description: Display incoming DATA:key:value or sensor JSON

send_text.description: Send exact literal text to micro:bit

drive_motor.description: Directional robot button; runtime sends CMD:motor:<direction>:<speed>. Use for forward/backward/left/right/stop, never plain set_motor for steering.

arguments.speedFrom: exact id of an included control widget with action set_motor; use instead of fixed speed for a shared slider

set_motor.description: Motor slider or button. Runtime builds CMD:motor:<speed>; stop is CMD:motor:0. Never invent action/stop text commands.

arguments.speed: fixed button: integer 0..80; 0 stops the motor
arguments.speedFrom: exact id of an included control widget with action set_motor; uses its current speed on click

camera_stream.description: Camera widget with built-in streaming start button, stop button and video display. Use ONE widget {type:camera_stream,action:{skill:camera_stream,source:{type:esp32_stream,url:...}}}; do not create separate camera button widgets or device commands. Can also combine with requested motor controls.

arguments.source: {type:esp32_stream,url:http://CAMERA_IP/stream}; use configured camera URL, never invent an IP

camera_capture.description: Capture labeled images locally from PC webcam or a direct ESP32 MJPEG source; no image upload

train_classifier.description: Train a dense classification head on frozen MobileNet CNN embeddings in the browser

classify_image.description: Predict a trained class from a webcam or ESP32 frame with a confidence threshold

evaluate_rules.description: Match a predicted label or compare it against a random opponent using configured beats pairs; send exact text via existing send_text

image_classifier.description: Reusable classifier widget combining camera_capture, train_classifier, classify_image and evaluate_rules

arguments.source: {type:webcam} (default), or {type:esp32_stream,url:http://CAMERA_IP/stream}; browser decodes frames directly, CNN remains in browser
arguments.model: mobilenet only; trained classifier weights can be included in exported HTML
arguments.rules: optional label rules: send_text{text}, set_motor{speed}, drive_motor{direction,speed}, set_servo{target,angle}; use only profile skills and fixed values
arguments.game: optional {beats:[[winner,loser]],winText,lossText,drawText}; one direction for every pair; choose rules OR game

legacy.label: micro:bit
legacy.description: Existing templates; the MakeCode program must implement selected sensor keys and commands.
